xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Deputy Commissioner GST, Rajasthan had raised the demand of tax of Rs 2,79,212, interest of Rs 2,21,966 and penalty of Rs 27,922 due to short payment of tax for FY 2020-21
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Short payment of tax for FY 2020-21
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company due to aforesaid Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The assessment order dated 20th November, 2023 u/s 143(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, for the assessment Year 2020-21, has made certain additions to the returned income of the Company, resulting in an aggregate demand of Rs. 6556.42 lakhs (including interest of Rs. 2239.35 lakhs).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: (1) Against the order of Income Tax Officer, appeal has been filed before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals), which is pending for disposal as on date. (2) Application for rectification of mistakes in the said order has also been filed before the Income TAx Officer, which is also pending for disposal as on date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Assistant Commissioner GST & Central Excise, Rayagada Division, Odisha
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Assistant Commissioner GST & Central Excise, Rayagada Division, Odisha, vide its Order dt. 08.12.2023, under Goods and Service Tax Act, has disallowed input tax credit of Rs. 36,50,730/- availed by the Company during the period July, 2017 to March, 2020, interest thereon and imposed penalty of Rs. 3,65,073/-.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Appeal has been filed before the Joint Commissioner, CGST, Bhubhaneshwar, which is pending as on date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Assistant Commissioner, GST & Central Excise, Rayagada Division, Odisha
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
The Assistant Commissioner, GST & Central Excise, Rayagada Division, Odisha, vide its separate Orders dt. 20.12.2023, under Goods and Service Tax Act, has denied Input Tax Credit (ITC) in respect of GST paid by the Company on purchase/availment of various goods and services and has raised the following demands:
(i) Tax demand of Rs. 53.74 lac alongwith applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 5.54 lac for the Financial Years 2017-18 to 2018-19.
(ii) Tax demand of Rs. 143.48 lac alongwith applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 14.50 lac for the Financial Years 2017-18 to 2019-20.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Appeal has been filed before the Joint Commissioner, CGST, Bhubhaneshwar, which is pending as on date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Assistant Commissioner, CGST Division, New Delhi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Assistant Commissioner, CGST Division, New Delhi, vide its Order dt. 27.12.2023, under Goods and Service Tax Act, has disallowed transitional credit and raised tax demand of Rs. 55.59 lac, interest thereon and imposed a penalty of Rs. 55.59 lac.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: (1) Against the order of Assistant Commissioner, WRIT petition has been filed before Delhi High Court, which is pending for disposal as on date. (2) Demand raised by the Assistant Commissioner has been stayed by Hon'ble Delhi High Court.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Additional Commissioner, GST & Central Excise, Bhubaneswar Commissionerate, Odisha
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Additional Commissioner, GST & Central Excise, Bhubaneswar Commissionerate, Odisha, vide its Order dt. 26.12.2023, under Goods and Service Tax Act, has denied Input Tax Credit in respect of GST paid by the Company on purchase/availment of various goods and services and has raised tax demand of Rs. 316.50 lac alongwith applicable interest and imposed a penalty of Rs. 31.65 lac for the financial years 2017-18 to 2019-20.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Commissioner (Appeals) has decided the case partially in faour of the company, pursuant to which demand of Rs. 203.70 lakhs (including tax demand of Rs. 195.20 lakhs and penalty of Rs. 18.50 lakhs) have been deleted. The company has paid the balance demand of Rs. 131.48 lakhs under GST Amnesty Scheme, purusant to which penalty of Rs. 13.15 lakhs will be waived off.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Assistant Commissioner, GST & Central Excise, Rayagada Division, Odisha
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Assistant Commissioner, GST & Central Excise, Rayagada Division, Odisha, vide its Order dt. 28.12.2023 under Goods and Service Tax Act, has raised tax demand of Rs. 27.79 lac, alongwith applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 5.36 lac for short/ delayed payment of tax for the financial years 2017-18 and 2019-20.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Appeal has been filed before the Joint Commissioner, CGST, Bhubhaneshwar, which is pending as on date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Goods and Service Tax Officer, Department of Trade and Taxes, Delhi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Goods and Service Tax Officer, Department of Trade and Taxes, Delhi, vide its order dated 31.12.2023 under Goods and Service Tax Act, has raised tax demand of Rs. 121.65 lacs, interest of Rs. 121.65 lacs and penalty of Rs. 12.16 lac alleging short payment of tax and excess claim of input tax credit during the financial year 2017-18.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Against the order of GST Officer, appeal has been filed before Dy. Commissioner of State Tax, Delhi, which is pending for disposal as on date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Assistant Commissioner, Sales Tax, Choolai Assessment Circle, Chennai
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Assistant Commissioner, Sales Tax, Choolai Assessment Circle, Chennai, vide its order dated 30.12.2023 under Goods and Service Tax Act, has raised a tax demand of Rs. 2.42 lac, interest of Rs. 2.47 lac and penalty of Rs. 0.30 lac, alleging short payment of tax during the financial year 2017-18.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The company has made the payment of tax for availing the benefit of waiver of interest and penalty under Amnesty Scheme introduced by GST Department. Further, the company is in the process of filing the necessary forms with the GST Officer.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Office of Superintendent of Central Tax Range-III, BBD Bag-I Division, Kolkata North CGST & Central Excise Commissionerate
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Office of Superintendent of Central Tax Range-III, BBD Bag-I Division, Kolkata North CGST & Central Excise Commissionerate, vide its order dated 28.02.2024 under Goods and Service Tax Act, has raised tax demand of Rs. 7.92 lac, applicable interest and penalty of Rs. 7.92 lac alleging that the Company has claimed excess lnput Tax Credit of said amount during the financial year 2018-19.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Commissioner (Appeals) has dismissed the appeal filed by the company against the order of Supritendent of central tax against which the company is in the process of filing WRIT petition before Calcutta High Court.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Office of the Assistant Commissioner (DGST) (Ward-201, 207 & 208), Govt. of NCT of Delhi, Department of Trade & Taxes
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Office of the Assistant Commissioner (DGST) (Ward-201, 207 & 208), Govt. of NCT of Delhi, Department of Trade & Taxes, vide its order dated 19th August 2024 under Goods and Service Tax Act, has raised demand of Rs. 25,45,072/- (comprising GST demand of Rs. 12,58,059/-, interest of Rs. 11,61,207/- and penalty of Rs. 1,25,806/-) for short payment of GST and excess claim of ITC, for the financial year 2019-20.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The company has filed appeal before Dy. Commissioner of State Tax, Delhi, which is pending for disposal as on date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Assistant Commissioner, Choolai Assessment Circle, Chennai
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Assistant Commissioner, Choolai Assessment Circle, Chennai has passed an assessment order dated 30th August, 2024 under Tamil Nadu Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 in respect of Chennai Depot of the Company, vide which total demand of Rs. 1,95,449/- (comprising GST demand Rs. 98,231/-,Interest of Rs. 77,218/- and Penalty of Rs. 20,000/-) has been raised for short payment of tax and excess claim of input tax credit, for the financial year 2019-20.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The company has made the payment of tax for availing the benefit of waiver of interest and penalty under Amnesty Scheme introduced by GST Department. Further, the company is in the process of filing the necessary forms with the GST Officer.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Assistant Commissioner, Mobile Squad, Lalitpur, Uttar Pradesh
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Assistant Commissioner, Mobile Squad, Lalitpur, Uttar Pradesh, has passed an Order dated 8th September 2024, vide which penalty of Rs. 5,08,516/- has been levied for quoting wrong GSTN of the recipient of the goods on the e-invoice, because of incorrect information being furnished to the Company. The penalty amount has already been deposited with the GST Authorities for release of the vehicle.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Dy. Commissioner of State Tax(Appeals) has deleted the penalty and matter is closed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: The Assistant Commissioner (Mobile Squad), Noida, Uttar Pradesh
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: A penalty of Rs. 4,33,156/- has been imposed by the Assistant Commissioner (Mobile Squad), Noida, Uttar Pradesh, under Goods and Service Tax Act, due to minor mismatch in address of customer found in e-way bill and invoice during transit of goods.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Commissioner (Appeals) has upheld the penalty against which, company will file appeal before the GST tribunal.
